Jordan Hayes
Senior DevOps & Cloud Platform Engineer
Austin, TX | jordan.hayes@email.com | +1 512-555-0144 | linkedin.com/in/jordanhayes-cloud | github.com/jordanhayes-devops

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing resilient AWS and GCP cloud environments, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and Kubernetes infrastructure at enterprise scale. Proven expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), GitOps, site reliability engineering, and cutting multi-region cloud spend while maintaining 99.99% system availability.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer | Nexus Cloud Systems | Austin, TX | 2021 - Present
- Architected multi-region AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Terragrunt across 45+ microservices, reducing provisioning time from 3 days to 15 minutes.
- Led production migration of monolithic workload to Amazon EKS (Kubernetes) and Helm, boosting cluster resource utilization by 40% and cutting AWS compute spend by $320K annually.
- Built enterprise GitOps deployment pipeline with ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, and Docker, reducing release cycle time from 2 hours to 6 minutes.
- Implemented comprehensive observability stack using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and OpenTelemetry, decreasing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by 65%.
- Instituted zero-trust cloud security protocols with HashiCorp Vault, AWS IAM, and Prisma Cloud, passing SOC 2 Type II compliance audit with zero findings.

DevOps Engineer | AgileFlow Software | Dallas, TX | 2018 - 2021
- Developed automated CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and Jenkins supporting 80+ software developers and 200+ daily builds.
- Managed multi-tenant Linux server fleets, PostgreSQL database clusters, and Redis instances with Ansible and automated backup policies.
- Orchestrated blue-green zero-downtime production deployments for high-traffic e-commerce platform processing $25M in monthly GMV.
- Authored Python and Bash automation scripts for automated drift detection, security compliance, and SSL certificate rotation.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems | University of Texas at Austin | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Cloud Platforms: AWS (EKS, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudFront, Route53), GCP, Microsoft Azure
- Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, CloudFormation, Packer
- Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, Istio Service Mesh
- CI/CD & Automation: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitOps, Bash, Python
- Observability & Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry
- Security & Networking: HashiCorp Vault, TLS/SSL, VPC Peering, OAuth, SOC 2, Linux Administration

CERTIFICATIONS
- AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional (2023)
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) (2022)
- HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (2021)
jobDescriptionText:
We are seeking a Senior DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to scale our AWS cloud platform. Requirements:
- 5+ years experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or SRE.
- Strong expertise in Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab).
- Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog monitoring.
- Knowledge of cloud security, Linux internals, and infrastructure automation in Python/Bash.
